note: Reference data about vendor support windows, not discovery output. Dates are the vendors' published roadmaps and must be reviewed by a maintainer before they are relied on; other JDK distributions (Temurin, Corretto, Zulu ...) publish their own, usually longer, windows. When a version is not listed the status is `unknown`, never guessed.

java.source: Oracle Java SE Support Roadmap (premier and extended support, by LTS release)
java.non_lts_note: Non-LTS feature releases are supported until the next release (about six months).

1.note: all 1.x lines are out of open-source support

2.note: 2.7 was the last 2.x line; its open-source support ended in November 2023 (commercial support is offered separately)

3.note: each 3.x minor line has its own open-source window; the minor version must be checked against the project's support page
